input.description: A neighbourhood bakery making sourdough bread and pastries every morning from organic flour, with same-day local delivery.
input.benefits:
Baked fresh every morning
Organic flour, no preservatives
Delivered to your door the same day
input.audience: busy families and young professionals in the city
input.problem: Supermarket bread goes stale in a day and tastes like nothing

concepts.title: Close-Up Craft
concepts.mainIdea: Let the product speak: slow, tactile close-ups of Bloom Bakery that reveal quality one detail at a time. Build it around the first bite, and feature the lead benefit: Baked fresh every morning.
concepts.audience: busy families and young professionals in the city
concepts.angle: Product as hero: sensory detail and texture over explanation.
concepts.message: Bloom Bakery is crafted down to the last detail.
concepts.visualDirection: Cinematic look: controlled contrast, shallow depth of field, motivated practical lighting and a restrained color grade. Setting: the restaurant kitchen and dining tables. Hero shot: steam rising from a freshly plated dish and hands breaking it open. Frame for 9:16 vertical.

concepts.title: The Moment That Matters
concepts.mainIdea: A short human story where Bloom Bakery is present in a meaningful moment, told with restraint and warmth. Build it around the first bite, and feature the lead benefit: Baked fresh every morning.
concepts.audience: busy families and young professionals in the city
concepts.angle: Emotional storytelling: the feeling comes first, the product supports the story.
concepts.hook: It is the small moments we remember.
concepts.message: Bloom Bakery is there for the moments that matter.
concepts.visualDirection: Cinematic look: controlled contrast, shallow depth of field, motivated practical lighting and a restrained color grade. Setting: the restaurant kitchen and dining tables. Hero shot: steam rising from a freshly plated dish and hands breaking it open. Frame for 9:16 vertical.

concepts.title: Behind the Process
concepts.mainIdea: Show the people, preparation and care behind Bloom Bakery so the audience understands why it is worth it. Build it around the first bite, and feature the lead benefit: Baked fresh every morning.
concepts.audience: busy families and young professionals in the city
concepts.angle: Authenticity: transparency about how it is made or delivered builds credibility.
concepts.hook: Let us show you how it is really made.
concepts.message: Real care goes into every Bloom Bakery experience.
concepts.visualDirection: Cinematic look: controlled contrast, shallow depth of field, motivated practical lighting and a restrained color grade. Setting: the restaurant kitchen and dining tables. Hero shot: steam rising from a freshly plated dish and hands breaking it open. Frame for 9:16 vertical.

concepts.title: Before & After
concepts.mainIdea: Build a clear visual contrast between life before and after Bloom Bakery, using one match-cut as the turning point. Build it around the first bite, and feature the lead benefit: Baked fresh every morning.
concepts.audience: busy families and young professionals in the city
concepts.angle: Transformation: the result is the hero, the product is the bridge.
concepts.hook: Watch what changes in just a few seconds.
concepts.message: Bloom Bakery turns the before into an after you can feel.
concepts.visualDirection: Cinematic look: controlled contrast, shallow depth of field, motivated practical lighting and a restrained color grade. Setting: the restaurant kitchen and dining tables. Hero shot: steam rising from a freshly plated dish and hands breaking it open. Frame for 9:16 vertical.

concepts.title: Old Way vs. New Way
concepts.mainIdea: Split the story into the old way and the Bloom Bakery way, side by side, so the difference is obvious without exaggeration. Build it around the first bite, and feature the lead benefit: Baked fresh every morning.
concepts.audience: busy families and young professionals in the city
concepts.angle: Comparison: contrast with a generic alternative, never with a named competitor.
concepts.hook: Same goal. Two very different ways.
concepts.message: Bloom Bakery is the smarter way to get it done.
concepts.visualDirection: Cinematic look: controlled contrast, shallow depth of field, motivated practical lighting and a restrained color grade. Setting: the restaurant kitchen and dining tables. Hero shot: steam rising from a freshly plated dish and hands breaking it open. Frame for 9:16 vertical.
